title: The planets
text: The Sun is a star. Around the Sun there are eight planets. Together they are the Solar System. Our planet, the Earth, is one of them.
Mercury is near the Sun. It is very hot in the day and very cold at night. Venus is between Mercury and the Earth. It is the hottest planet.
The Earth is the third planet from the Sun. It has water, air and life. Mars is next to the Earth. It is red because it has a lot of red dust.
Jupiter is behind Mars. It is the biggest planet. It has a big red spot: it is a giant storm! Saturn is famous for its rings of ice and rock.
Uranus and Neptune are far from the Sun. They are very cold and blue. On Neptune the wind is very, very strong. Which planet is your favorite?
